# Regex to Automaton & Kleene's Theorem

This notebook walks through **Kleene's Theorem** interactively in three steps:

1. **Write a regex** → the notebook builds the corresponding NFA via Thompson's construction.
2. **Choose states $i$, $j$ and frontier $k$** → the notebook highlights which states are "allowed" as intermediates.
3. **Read off $R_{i,j}^k$** → the regular expression for all words that go from $q_i$ to $q_j$ using only $q_1, \ldots, q_k$ as intermediate stops.

The key recurrence is:
$$
  R_{i,j}^k =
  R_{i,j}^{k-1}
  +
  R_{i,k}^{k-1}(R_{k,k}^{k-1})^*R_{k,j}^{k-1}
$$

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  const EPS  = "ε";
  const EMPTY = "∅";

  /* ──────────────────────────────────────────
     REGEX PARSER
  ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  class RegexParser {
    constructor(str) { this.str = str.replace(/\s+/g, ''); this.pos = 0; }
    peek() { return this.pos < this.str.length ? this.str[this.pos] : null; }
    eat(c) { if (this.peek() === c) { this.pos++; return true; } return false; }
    parse() {
      if (!this.str.length) return { type: 'eps' };
      const r = this.parseE();
      if (this.pos < this.str.length) throw new Error("Unexpected character at position " + this.pos + " ('" + this.str[this.pos] + "')");
      return r;
    }
    parseE() {
      let f = this.parseT();
      while (this.eat('+')) f = { type:'union', left:f, right:this.parseT() };
      return f;
    }
    parseT() {
      let f = this.parseF();
      while (this.peek() && this.peek() !== '+' && this.peek() !== ')') f = { type:'concat', left:f, right:this.parseF() };
      return f;
    }
    parseF() {
      let f = this.parseB();
      while (this.eat('*')) f = { type:'star', inner:f };
      return f;
    }
    parseB() {
      if (this.eat('(')) {
        const f = this.parseE();
        if (!this.eat(')')) throw new Error("Missing closing ')'");
        return f;
      }
      const c = this.peek();
      if (c && /[a-z0-9]/i.test(c)) { this.pos++; return { type:'symbol', char:c }; }
      throw new Error("Unexpected character: '" + c + "'");
    }
  }

  /* ──────────────────────────────────────────
     THOMPSON CONSTRUCTION
  ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let sc = 1;
  const ns = () => "q" + sc++;
  const addEps = (t, from, to) => { if (!t[from]) t[from]={}; if (!t[from][EPS]) t[from][EPS]=[]; t[from][EPS].push(to); };

  function compile(ast) {
    if (ast.type === 'eps') {
      const [s,e] = [ns(),ns()];
      const t={}; addEps(t,s,e);
      return {start:s,end:e,t,alph:new Set()};
    }
    if (ast.type === 'symbol') {
      const [s,e] = [ns(),ns()];
      const t={}; t[s]={}; t[s][ast.char]=[e];
      return {start:s,end:e,t,alph:new Set([ast.char])};
    }
    if (ast.type === 'concat') {
      const L=compile(ast.left), R=compile(ast.right);
      const t=Object.assign({},L.t,R.t);
      addEps(t,L.end,R.start);
      return {start:L.start,end:R.end,t,alph:new Set([...L.alph,...R.alph])};
    }
    if (ast.type === 'union') {
      const L=compile(ast.left), R=compile(ast.right);
      const [s,e]=[ns(),ns()];
      const t=Object.assign({},L.t,R.t);
      t[s]={}; t[s][EPS]=[L.start,R.start];
      addEps(t,L.end,e); addEps(t,R.end,e);
      return {start:s,end:e,t,alph:new Set([...L.alph,...R.alph])};
    }
    if (ast.type === 'star') {
      const I=compile(ast.inner);
      const [s,e]=[ns(),ns()];
      const t=Object.assign({},I.t);
      t[s]={}; t[s][EPS]=[I.start,e];
      addEps(t,I.end,I.start); addEps(t,I.end,e);
      return {start:s,end:e,t,alph:I.alph};
    }
  }

  function buildNFA(regStr) {
    sc = 1;
    const ast = new RegexParser(regStr).parse();
    const nfa = compile(ast);
    const st = new Set([nfa.start,nfa.end]);
    for (const s in nfa.t) { st.add(s); for (const sym in nfa.t[s]) nfa.t[s][sym].forEach(x=>st.add(x)); }
    const states = [...st].sort((a,b)=>+a.slice(1) - +b.slice(1));
    const alphabet = [...nfa.alph, EPS];
    states.forEach(s => { if (!nfa.t[s]) nfa.t[s]={}; });
    return { states, alphabet, initial:nfa.start, finals:[nfa.end], transitions:nfa.t };
  }

  /* ──────────────────────────────────────────
     KLEENE EXPRESSION ALGEBRA
  ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const sn = s => +s.slice(1);
  const lR = (i,j,k) => `R<sub>${sn(i)},${sn(j)}</sub><sup>${k}</sup>`;

  const union = (a,b) => a===EMPTY?b : b===EMPTY?a : a===b?a : a+" + "+b;
  const unionMany = ps => ps.reduce(union, EMPTY);

  function wrapC(e) {
    if (e===EPS||e===EMPTY) return e;
    if (/^[a-z0-9]$/i.test(e)) return e;
    if (/^[a-z0-9]\*$/i.test(e)) return e;
    if (/^\(.+\)\*$/.test(e)) return e;
    return "("+e+")";
  }
  function concat(...ps) {
    if (ps.some(p=>p===EMPTY)) return EMPTY;
    const r=ps.filter(p=>p!==EPS);
    return r.length===0 ? EPS : r.map(wrapC).join("");
  }
  function star(e) {
    if (e===EMPTY||e===EPS) return EPS;
    if (/^[a-z0-9]$/i.test(e)) return e+"*";
    if (/^[a-z0-9]\*$/i.test(e)) return e;  // already a single-letter star
    return "("+e+")*";
  }

  function buildLevels(aut) {
    const L = [{}];
    aut.states.forEach(f => {
      L[0][f]={};
      aut.states.forEach(t => {
        const ps = [];
        if (f===t) ps.push(EPS);
        aut.alphabet.forEach(sym => {
          if (aut.transitions[f]?.[sym]?.includes(t)) ps.push(sym);
        });
        L[0][f][t] = unionMany(ps);
      });
    });
    for (let k=1; k<=aut.states.length; k++) {
      const qk=aut.states[k-1];
      L[k]={};
      aut.states.forEach(f => {
        L[k][f]={};
        aut.states.forEach(t => {
          const via = concat(L[k-1][f][qk], star(L[k-1][qk][qk]), L[k-1][qk][t]);
          L[k][f][t] = union(L[k-1][f][t], via);
        });
      });
    }
    return L;
  }

  /* ──────────────────────────────────────────
     NFA SIMULATION
  ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function eClosure(aut, states) {
    const cl=new Set(states), q=[...states];
    while (q.length) { const s=q.shift(); (aut.transitions[s]?.[EPS]||[]).forEach(n=>{ if(!cl.has(n)){cl.add(n);q.push(n);} }); }
    return [...cl];
  }

  function acceptsNFA(aut, word) {
    let cur=eClosure(aut,[aut.initial]);
    for (const sym of word) {
      const nx=new Set();
      cur.forEach(s=>(aut.transitions[s]?.[sym]||[]).forEach(n=>nx.add(n)));
      cur=eClosure(aut,[...nx]);
    }
    return cur.some(s=>aut.finals.includes(s));
  }

  function inR(aut, start, end, k, word) {
    const key = (s,wi) => s+"|"+wi;
    function dfs(s, wi, seen) {
      if (wi===word.length && s===end) return true;
      const k2=key(s,wi);
      if (seen.has(k2)) return false;
      seen.add(k2);
      for (const nx of (aut.transitions[s]?.[EPS]||[])) {
        if (nx===end || sn(nx)<=k) if (dfs(nx,wi,seen)) return true;
      }
      if (wi<word.length) {
        const sym=word[wi];
        for (const nx of (aut.transitions[s]?.[sym]||[])) {
          if (nx===end || sn(nx)<=k) if (dfs(nx,wi+1,seen)) return true;
        }
      }
      return false;
    }
    return dfs(start, 0, new Set());
  }

  function wordsUpTo(aut, maxLen) {
    const alph=aut.alphabet.filter(a=>a!==EPS);
    let words=[""], layer=[""];
    for (let l=1;l<=maxLen;l++) {
      const next=[];
      layer.forEach(p=>alph.forEach(c=>next.push(p+c)));
      words=[...words,...next]; layer=next;
    }
    return words;
  }

  /* ──────────────────────────────────────────
     VIS-NETWORK GRAPH
  ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let network=null;

  function renderGraph(aut, i, j, k) {
    const nodeArr = aut.states.map(s => {
      const allowed = sn(s)<=k && k>0;
      const isAccept = aut.finals.includes(s);
      const isI = s===i, isJ = s===j;
      let bg='#daf3fc', border='#30bced', bw=2;
      if (allowed)  { bg='#ead6f8'; border='#9b59b6'; }
      if (isAccept) { bg='#c9f2e8'; border='#1db87a'; }
      if (isI) { bg='#fde8d8'; border='#f05e23'; bw=4; }
      if (isJ && !isI) { border='#1a7fa3'; bw=4; }
      return {
        id:s, label:s, shape:'circle',
        color:{ background:bg, border, highlight:{ background:bg, border } },
        borderWidth:bw,
        font:{ size:15, face:'ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace', bold:true }
      };
    });
    nodeArr.push({ id:'__start', shape:'dot', size:1, opacity:0, fixed:true });

    const edgeArr = [];
    edgeArr.push({ from:'__start', to:aut.initial, label:'start', arrows:'to',
      color:{ color:'#f05e23' }, font:{ align:'top', size:12, color:'#f05e23' } });
    aut.states.forEach(from=>{
      const targets={};
      aut.alphabet.forEach(sym=>(aut.transitions[from]?.[sym]||[]).forEach(to=>{
        if(!targets[to]) targets[to]=[];
        targets[to].push(sym==='ε'?'ε':sym);
      }));
      Object.entries(targets).forEach(([to,syms])=>{
        edgeArr.push({
          from, to, label:syms.join(','),
          arrows:'to',
          color:{ color:'#555' },
          font:{ align:'horizontal', size:13, background:'rgba(255,255,255,.85)' },
          smooth:{ type:'curvedCW', roundness:from===to?0.6:0.15 }
        });
      });
    });

    const data = { nodes: new vis.DataSet(nodeArr), edges: new vis.DataSet(edgeArr) };
    const opts = {
      layout:{ hierarchical:{ direction:'LR', sortMethod:'directed', nodeSpacing:70, levelSeparation:130, blockShifting:true, edgeMinimization:true } },
      physics:false,
      interaction:{ dragNodes:true, zoomView:true, dragView:true, hover:true },
      edges:{ width:2, selectionWidth:3, font:{ size:13 } },
      nodes:{ margin:10 }
    };
    if (network) { network.setData(data); }
    else { network = new vis.Network(document.getElementById('ke8-graph'), data, opts); }
  }

  /* ──────────────────────────────────────────
     UI HELPERS
  ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function setLabels(i,j,k) {
    ['lbl-i','lbl-i2'].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).textContent=sn(i));
    ['lbl-j','lbl-j2'].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).textContent=sn(j));
    ['lbl-k','lbl-k2'].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).textContent=k);
  }

  function renderComponents(aut, L, i, j, k) {
    const el = document.getElementById('ke8-components');
    if (k===0) {
      el.innerHTML = `<p style="color:var(--c-muted);font-size:.92rem;margin:0">
        At <strong>k = 0</strong> there are no intermediate states allowed.
        R<sub>${sn(i)},${sn(j)}</sub><sup>0</sup> contains only ε (if i = j) and direct single-symbol transitions from q<sub>${sn(i)}</sub> to q<sub>${sn(j)}</sub>.
      </p>`;
      return;
    }
    const qk=aut.states[k-1];
    const rows=[
      ['Avoid '+qk,       lR(i,j,k-1),      L[k-1][i][j]],
      ['Enter '+qk,       lR(i,qk,k-1),     L[k-1][i][qk]],
      ['Loop at '+qk,     '('+lR(qk,qk,k-1)+')<sup>*</sup>', star(L[k-1][qk][qk])],
      ['Exit '+qk,        lR(qk,j,k-1),     L[k-1][qk][j]],
    ];
    const body=rows.map(([part,sym,expr])=>`
      <tr>
        <td class="label">${part}</td>
        <td class="mono">${sym}</td>
        <td class="mono">${expr}</td>
      </tr>`).join('');
    el.innerHTML=`
      <table class="ke8-table">
        <thead><tr><th>Role</th><th>Sub-expression</th><th>Value</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>${body}</tbody>
      </table>`;
  }

  function renderExamples(aut, i, j, k) {
    const el=document.getElementById('ke8-examples');
    const hits=wordsUpTo(aut,4).filter(w=>inR(aut,i,j,k,w));
    if (!hits.length) {
      el.innerHTML=`<span class="ke8-word empty-lang">no words of length ≤ 4</span>`;
      return;
    }
    el.innerHTML=hits.map(w=>`<span class="ke8-word">${w||EPS}</span>`).join('');
  }

  function renderVerdict(aut, i, j, k) {
    const raw=document.getElementById('ke8-word').value.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi,'').toLowerCase();
    document.getElementById('ke8-word').value=raw;
    const w=raw||'';
    const inRij=inR(aut,i,j,k,w);
    const accepted=acceptsNFA(aut,w);
    const el=document.getElementById('ke8-verdict');
    el.className='ke8-verdict '+(inRij?'ok':'fail');
    const wLabel=`<code>${w||EPS}</code>`;
    const rLabel=lR(i,j,k);
    el.innerHTML=`
      ${wLabel} <strong>${inRij?'✓ belongs to':'✗ does not belong to'}</strong> ${rLabel}<br>
      From the initial state: ${wLabel} is <strong>${accepted?'✓ accepted':'✗ rejected'}</strong> by the NFA.
    `;
  }

  /* ──────────────────────────────────────────
     MAIN RENDER
  ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let currentAut=null, currentL=null, blocked=false;

  function populate(aut) {
    blocked=true;
    const ks=document.getElementById('ke8-k');
    const is=document.getElementById('ke8-i');
    const js=document.getElementById('ke8-j');
    ks.innerHTML=''; for(let k=0;k<=aut.states.length;k++) { const o=document.createElement('option'); o.value=k; o.textContent=k; ks.appendChild(o); }
    ks.value=aut.states.length;
    [is,js].forEach(sel=>{ sel.innerHTML=''; aut.states.forEach(s=>{ const o=document.createElement('option'); o.value=s; o.textContent=s; sel.appendChild(o); }); });
    is.value=aut.initial;
    js.value=aut.finals[0];
    blocked=false;
  }

  function render() {
    if (blocked||!currentAut) return;
    const k=+document.getElementById('ke8-k').value;
    const i=document.getElementById('ke8-i').value;
    const j=document.getElementById('ke8-j').value;
    setLabels(i,j,k);
    document.getElementById('ke8-selected').innerHTML = `<span class="lhs">${lR(i,j,k)}</span> = ${currentL[k][i][j]}`;
    renderGraph(currentAut, i, j, k);
    renderComponents(currentAut, currentL, i, j, k);
    renderExamples(currentAut, i, j, k);
    renderVerdict(currentAut, i, j, k);
  }

  function update() {
    const err=document.getElementById('ke8-error');
    try {
      err.style.display='none';
      const raw=document.getElementById('ke8-regex').value.trim();
      if (!raw) return;
      currentAut=buildNFA(raw);
      currentL=buildLevels(currentAut);
      populate(currentAut);
      render();
    } catch(e) {
      err.textContent='⚠ '+e.message;
      err.style.display='block';
    }
  }

  document.getElementById('ke8-regex').addEventListener('input', update);
  ['ke8-k','ke8-i','ke8-j'].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('change', render));
  document.getElementById('ke8-word').addEventListener('input', ()=>{ if(currentAut) renderVerdict(currentAut, document.getElementById('ke8-i').value, document.getElementById('ke8-j').value, +document.getElementById('ke8-k').value); });

  update();
})();
</script>
```

## What to notice

When **k = 0**: $R_{i,j}^0$ contains only $\varepsilon$ (if $i = j$) and the labels of any direct edges from $q_i$ to $q_j$. No intermediate stops allowed.

When **k increases by 1**: the recurrence adds exactly the paths that use the newly unlocked state $q_k$ as an intermediate. The star $(R_{k,k}^{k-1})^*$ covers paths that loop back through $q_k$ zero or more times before leaving.

When **k = n**: $R_{i,j}^n$ is unrestricted — any path is allowed — and $R_{q_0,f}^n$ for each accepting state $f$ gives one of the summands of the final regular expression.
